title: A CEO reads the book against the coming wave of ownership transitions — 'good intentions can only take us so far'
summary: More than half of US businesses with employees are owned by someone over 55, so a great many will change hands this decade. Parsons runs Knowledge Architecture and wants employee ownership trusts and perpetual purpose trusts better known than a sale to private equity.
blockquote:
What I appreciate about Incorruptible is the way Ries connects a company’s purpose to the structures that govern its future.

Good intentions can only take us so far. If we want a company to stay true to its mission over decades and through leadership transitions, we need ownership structures, governance, and incentives that support that commitment.
